title: Question 17
passage:
Who checks that both drawings show the connector facing the same way?
A. The drawings are saved in the same folder. B. Turn the drawing so the title is at the bottom. C. Rafi compares them before they are issued.
passageZh:
誰會確認兩張圖面上的連接器朝向一致？
A. 圖面儲存在同一個資料夾。 B. 轉一下圖面，讓標題位於底部。 C. Rafi 會在圖面發行前比對。
